metadata.case_name: SIU KIN KEUNG ANTHONY v. H & M HENNES & MAURITZ LIMITED

plaintiff.education_level: National Diploma in Design Crafts (Camberwell College of Arts); Menswear Design (London College of Fashion)

injuries.description: Severe head injury with skull fracture, large epidural haematoma over right parietal and occipital regions, small frontal brain contusion and torn transverse sinus; evidence of previous transverse sinus thrombosis with recanalization
injuries.body_part: head (right parietal and occipital regions; frontal)
source: Urgent CT scan revealed skull fracture and a large epidural hematoma over right parietal and occipital region, small frontal brain contusion. Emergency operation was performed to evacuation of hematoma and repairing of torn transverse sinus, as a life saving procedure.

Mr. Siu sustained a severe head injury complicated by an epidural haematoma from a torn transverse sinus. He had post-traumatic amnesia of about 30 hour. CT revealed a skull fracture and a large epidural haematoma over the right parietal and occipital regions, and a small frontal brain contusion.
The latest MRI revealed evidence of previous transverse sinus thrombosis with recanalization.
we agree that in the accident, there was also mild injury of the neck and the lumbar region.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

injuries.description: Mild injury of the lumbar region
source: we agree that in the accident, there was also mild injury of the neck and the lumbar region.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: Craniotomy scar (long curved craniotomy scar at the right occipital region, about 7 inches)
source: It was a long (about 7 inches) curved craniotomy scar at the right occipital region.

manifestations.description: Impairment of memory / short-term memory problems / needs written reminders / may misplace belongings
Irritability / temper outbursts / reduced frustration tolerance / neurobehavioural impairment
Mild hearing problem / mild conductive hearing impairment (audiogram October 2009)
Height phobia / hesitation to work at height / fear of working at height
Needs to take notes for essential work schedules and appointments (to cope with memory problems)

treatments_received: Admission to Department of Neurosurgery, Kwong Wah Hospital (14/2/2008)
Emergency operation to evacuate epidural hematoma and repair torn transverse sinus
Management in High Dependence Unit and inpatient neurosurgical care
Reviewed by neurologist Dr Gardian Fong
Joint neurological expert assessment (Dr So and Dr Yu)
7 sessions of cognitive behavioural therapy with Dr Chan (clinical psychologist)
treatments_future: If opting for private care, 6-monthly consultations with a neurologist or neurosurgeon (at about $700 per visit) until February 2012 would be recommended
Professor Lee recommended at least 10 sessions of psychological treatment (HK$3,000 per session)

losses.description: Residual neurocognitive impairments including short-term memory problems, need for written reminders, reduced concentration and daily forgetfulness.
Long (about 7 inches) curved craniotomy scar at the right occipital region.
Difficulty and hesitation to work at height after the accident leading to resignation from pre-accident employment as visual merchandiser and a period of unemployment.
Irritability / temper outbursts / reduced frustration tolerance / neurobehavioural impairment
